text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Camera-guided controller for the single faucet-close episode.
+
+Reads JSON commands on stdin. All perception uses the public RGB/depth
+cameras, calibration, and robot proprioception. No simulator state is read.
+Executed commands and native actions are saved beside the observations.
+"""
+import json
+import math
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+CAMERAS = ["front", "left", "right", "topview"]
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    current = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True)
+    index = max([int(p.name) for p in OUT.iterdir() if p.name.isdigit()] + [0])
+
+    def record(obs, command, actions=None):
+        nonlocal current, index
+        current = obs
+        index += 1
+        dest = OUT / f"{index:03d}"
+        obs.save(str(dest))
+        (dest / "command.json").write_text(json.dumps(command, indent=2))
+        if actions is not None:
+            np.save(dest / "actions.npy", actions)
+        canvas = Image.new("RGB", (640, 480))
+        for i, cam in enumerate(CAMERAS):
+            if cam in obs.last:
+                im = Image.fromarray(obs.last[cam])
+                ImageDraw.Draw(im).text((8, 8), cam, fill="white")
+                canvas.paste(im, ((i % 2) * 320, (i // 2) * 240))
+        canvas.save("/app/output/latest.png")
+        state = dict(zip(obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"], obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+        print(json.dumps({"run": str(dest), "tcp": [state[f"tcp_{x}"] for x in "xyz"],
+                          "mocap": [state[f"mocap_{x}"] for x in "xyz"],
+                          "opening": state["gripper_opening"],
+                          "steps": obs.meta["control_steps"],
+                          "time_left": obs.meta["time_left_s"]}), flush=True)
+
+    record(current, {"op": "initial"})
+    for line in sys.stdin:
+        try:
+            cmd = json.loads(line)
+            op = cmd["op"]
+            if op == "quit":
+                break
+            if op == "observe":
+                result = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True,
+                                       seconds=cmd.get("seconds", 0))
+                record(result, cmd)
+                continue
+            state = dict(zip(current.meta["proprio"]["layout"], current.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+            grip = cmd.get("grip", state["cmd_grip"])
+            if op == "move":
+                tcp = np.array([state[f"tcp_{x}"] for x in "xyz"])
+                delta = np.array(cmd["tcp"]) - tcp
+                n = max(1, math.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta)) / cmd.get("speed", .003)))
+                actions = np.tile(np.r_[delta / (.01 * n), grip], (n, 1))
+                settle = cmd.get("settle", 12)
+                if settle:
+                    actions = np.vstack([actions, np.tile([0, 0, 0, grip], (settle, 1))])
+            elif op == "actions":
+                actions = np.array(cmd["actions"], dtype=np.float64)
+            elif op == "hold":
+                actions = np.tile([0, 0, 0, grip], (cmd.get("steps", 20), 1))
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(op)
+            result = robot.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=spec["control_dt"],
+                                  cameras=CAMERAS, video="both", video_fps=20,
+                                  include_depth=True, note=cmd.get("note", op))
+            record(result, cmd, actions)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print(json.dumps({"error": repr(exc)}), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
